answer: Every agent identity should anchor to a bonded wharf of verifiable work: to earn standing, an agent must complete graded tasks whose output is re-checked by independent peers, and each identity posts a refundable bond that is slashed when its work fails re-checks. A sybil farm hits its nadir here — every extra copy must post its own bond and pay its own grading cost, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times the honest price, while one honest agent pays once.
